rerun_policy: INSUFFICIENT_DATA (either arm under 5 scorable rows) = unmeasured unless replaced. No partial rerun: `arcforge eval ab` has no arm/trial selector (runAbTrials in scripts/lib/eval.js:160-181 schedules both arms; stopIfTrialWroteRepo in scripts/lib/eval-trial.js:341-348 ends the run on trial_wrote_repo; a smaller --k adds rows to both pools). The scheduled round is 26 sessions (sessions 3 + 10, router 3 + 10; verify-exit 0, design-gate.verify-exit.md). ONE full 10-session replacement of one INSUFFICIENT_DATA A/B is allowed (26 + 10 = 36 <= ~40); a second INSUFFICIENT_DATA, in the same or the other scenario, is recorded as unmeasured (a second replacement = 46). The replacement reuses the existing preflight record (same scenario hash and conditions). The first run's rows stay in evals/results/ and the engine cannot exclude them by run (eval report / eval compare pool by Version + conditions); the verdict is the replacement run's own eval ab summary, the ledger names the first run's id (its evals/results/<scenario>/<runId>/ directory) as the recorded error run, and any pooled reading uses --since <replacement start>. Preflight BLOCK: no A/B, no second preflight. (Codex P1 on #276, superseding the P2 wording.)
